theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_radial_height
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (R r₁ ε m : ℝ), 0 < r₁ → r₁ < R → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ m → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → u 0 = 0 → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) r₁, ‖u x‖ ≤ ε * ‖x‖) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) R, ENNReal.ofReal (‖u x - fderiv ℝ u x x‖ ^ 2 / ‖x‖ ^ (n + 2)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal m → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, ‖u x‖ ≤ (ε + C * (Real.log (R / r₁) * m) ^ (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) * ‖x‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
